newsitem.title: UK: Insurance rates stable or falling - industry.
newsitem.headline: Insurance rates stable or falling - industry.

text.p: Speakers at a London International Insurance and Reinsurance Market Association (LIRMA) meeting on Tuesday said early signs from the current renewal season indicated that insurance and reinsurance rates were falling or remaining stable.

"Some reinsurers are desperate to get market share at any price," Chris Ballard of St Paul Re, a part of St Paul Cos Inc, told a LIRMA forum meeting on the renewal season, adding that little business had been concluded in the UK yet, where quotes were still being considered.

However, some international reinsurance business had been renewed, with some European insurers opting to remain with their existing programmes, despite in some cases having received more competitive offers.
Robert Johnston of Mercantile & General, a part of Swiss Re, said it was still early days in the renewal process and companies were quoting a lot of business, but with little response so far.
Johnston, who spoke to the meeting about developments in personal accident, said his assessment of the renewal season was that rates were largely stable.
